dependencies.name: croc (engine package)
dependencies.note: Compiled directly into this binary — powers internet send/receive. Relayed through croc's own public relay, which only ever sees end-to-end-encrypted ciphertext, never file contents. Not a separate install; listed for transparency about what this app is built on.

dependencies.name: go-qrcode
dependencies.note: Compiled directly into this binary — generates the QR code for the on-Wi-Fi share link. Not a separate install.

requirements.name: Chrome or Chromium-based browser
requirements.note: Any Chromium-based browser works: Google Chrome, Chromium, Brave, Microsoft Edge, or Arc. Used to render the app's own UI window, same as the rest of this family of apps.
